title: Boy in White Suit, Fullerton CA Brick Wall - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
817 A

FADE PROOF

SEP 6 1938

Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
description: Full-length outdoor snapshot portrait of a smiling young boy standing proudly with his hands behind his back against a white-painted brick wall. He is dressed formally in a tailored white double-breasted suit jacket, matching trousers, a white collared shirt, and a dark-striped necktie, possibly for a religious ceremony (such as a confirmation or communion) or an end-of-summer celebration in 1938. The back bears a blue processing stamp reading 'FADE PROOF SEP 6 1938 Finished by B. D. WOOD Fullerton, California' and the order number '817 A', with black album paper remnant marks at the corners.
